requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Getting Started with Memot"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Memot is a note-taking app that lets you combine text, tables, and images into one place."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This guide uses the examples of Yamanashi-san from PR and Takanashi-san from Sales to explain."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "A short note added to a page is called a \"Quick Note\" (ひとこと)."}, {"id": 1, "text": "月見里さん records the decisions from meetings in a Quick Note."}, {"id": 2, "text": "月見里さん puts sticky notes on important parts to mark them."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You can add up to ten notes per page."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Use it with your team"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Mr. Takanashi's sales team first created a workspace."}, {"id": 2, "text": "The place in a workspace that everyone can see is called \"Hiroba\" (Commons)."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Anyone can post a note in the Commons."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Takanashi shares the sales schedule in the Commons every morning."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can invite members to the workspace by email."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The invited person will receive a confirmation email."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Once an administrator approves, you can join right away."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Member permissions can also be changed for each plaza."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Sync and History"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes are saved automatically and synced to all your devices."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can edit them offline, and they sync right away when you reconnect."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can restore an earlier version from the page history."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Mr. Yamanashi got back the text he had accidentally deleted."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Tips for organizing"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Pinning important pages is convenient."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Pinned pages appear at the top of the list."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes in Hiroba are easier to find when you add tags."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can create tags freely ◆"}, {"id": 2, "text": "小鳥遊さn sorts tags by project."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The same tag can also be used for a single word or phrase."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In search, you can look for both 広場 and ひとこと at the same time."}, {"id": 1, "text": "If you can't find something, try widening the search scope."}]}
